lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.22 - A Look & learn

details: Look & learn helps students recognise key vocabulary and sentence structures by providing examples of grammar in a table. It reinforces correct grammar structures and prepares them for writing and speaking activities.
Look for good understanding of the use of Future will, clear pronunciation, and active participation.
“Here is a riddle! Will you help me use will correctly? Won’t you help me use won’t correctly? Let’s look at the table together.”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.22 - B. Complete the sentences using will.

details: Complete the sentences using will helps students practise forming positive future sentences. It strengthens their ability to make predictions, promises, and plans using the correct structure.
Look for correct use of will and base verb, correct sentences, neat writing.
“Help! The middle has fallen out of my sentences. Can you use the word will to help me complete them correctly?”

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.22 - C. Complete the sentences using will or won’t.

details: Complete the sentences using will or won’t helps students choose between positive and negative future actions. It reinforces understanding of meaning and sentence accuracy.
Look for correct use of will or won’t, answers that fit the context and accurate writing.
“Do you know what will happen in the future? Be a future detective to work out what will and won’t happen.”
